rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's current energy must be strictly greater than that power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, there must be a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and the gun must point at it within 3.0°; with no target or a stale scan it never fires.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever it drives forward, the free distance ahead minus the distance driven must remain at least 80 pixels, and whenever it drives backward, the free distance behind minus the distance driven backward must remain at least 80 pixels; if it does not drive, this requires nothing.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

explanation.headline: Proved: all 3 rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved all three rules: S1 (never fire a shot it can't afford), S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn with the gun aimed), and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). Neither battle, the open arena or the urban map, showed any rule violations.
